dataset_info.notes: Voice-assistant utterances from OVOS intents-for-eval reused as a multilingual TTS read-aloud prompt set. TTS has no objective metric — fighters synthesise each prompt and the clips are assembled into blind A/B listening battles (human votes only, no benchmark board, no ELO seed). Cap with --max-samples for manageable battle pools. an-ES, ast-ES and fy-NL were added to cover phoonnx fighters that previously had zero TTS prompt coverage: their `utterance` rows are read-aloud sentences (not real intents) sampled deterministically (dedup, <=200 chars, first 200 after dedup) from the public transcripts of the Common Voice-derived corpora phoonnx trained its an/ast/fy-NL voices on (TigreGotico/tts_vc_mcv-scripted-v23.0_an_dii, TigreGotico/tts_vc_mcv-scripted-v23.0_ast_dii, TigreGotico/tts-vc-mcv-scripted-v24.0-fy-nl-dii on HuggingFace, all cc-by-nc-nd-4.0 — noncommercial, unlike the apache-2.0 license covering the rest of this dataset). oc-FR (Occitan) has a phoonnx fighter but NO transcript source dataset was found in the OpenVoiceOS or TigreGotico HF orgs, so it remains uncovered. oc-FR prompts derive from shunyalabs/occitan-speech-dataset transcripts (200 sentences, license unspecified upstream; eval-only use).
